versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.2 - Adds usage triggers, non-use scenarios, and clarifies boundaries.

- Added detailed "Triggers" and "Near-miss / Do NOT use" sections in documentation to clarify usage entry points and scope boundaries.
- Expanded bilingual user-phrase/match examples to improve clarity and accessibility.
- Explicitly documented out-of-scope scenarios (e.g., requiring config changes or non-CDN issues).
- No changes to technical logic or interface; core functionality and workflow remain read-only.
- Removed redundant `skill-card.md` file.

- Initial release of the "huawei-cloud-cdn-abnormal-status-code-analysis" skill.
- Provides read-only diagnosis of abnormal HTTP 4xx/5xx status codes on Huawei Cloud CDN domains.
- Differentiates between edge-generated and origin-generated errors, and pinpoints affected codes, time windows, and root causes.
- Includes log extraction helper for per-request forensics and top-N analysis for user/path distribution.
- Strictly prohibits all write, modify, or delete operations for security; only GET/read actions are allowed.
- Uses hcloud CLI and Python tools, with comprehensive security and operation pre-checks.
